summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K covering August 2026 treasury-share activity under CVM Resolution 44/2021. The filing discloses a closing treasury balance of 42,150,391 Class A preferred shares held by the company, with no securities or derivatives operations executed during the month, and includes the standard individual-form treasury holdings table. It is signed by CFO Carlos Augusto Machado Pereira de Almeida Brandao, dated September 10, 2026, and carries boilerplate forward-looking-statement language. No transaction, stake change, price, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated, so no special-situation or risk-arb angle applies.
